<script>
const cv=document.getElementById('bg'),R=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas:cv,alpha:true,antialias:true});
R.setPixelRatio(Math.min(devicePixelRatio,2));const S=new THREE.Scene(),C=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(50,1,.1,100);C.position.z=9;
S.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff,.8));const L=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,1);L.position.set(4,6,8);S.add(L);
const tex=new THREE.TextureLoader().load('data:image/jpeg;base64,');
const side=new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0x9fd8f0,metalness:.2,roughness:.5}),face=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({map:tex});
const disc=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(4.8,2.7,.22),[side,side,side,side,face,face]);
const g=new THREE.Group();g.add(disc);S.add(g);
const bub=[];const bm=new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({color:0x7dd3fc,transparent:true,opacity:.45,roughness:.05,metalness:0,clearcoat:1});
for(let i=0;i<34;i++){const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(.12+Math.random()*.4,24,24),bm);m.position.set((Math.random()-.5)*16,(Math.random()-.5)*18,(Math.random()-.5)*6-1);m.userData={s:.2+Math.random()*.6,o:Math.random()*6};S.add(m);bub.push(m)}
function star(){const s=new THREE.Shape(),n=4,o=.35,i=.08;for(let k=0;k<n*2;k++){const r=k%2?i:o,a=k/(n*2)*Math.PI*2;k?s.lineTo(Math.cos(a)*r,Math.sin(a)*r):s.moveTo(Math.cos(a)*r,Math.sin(a)*r)}return new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ShapeGeometry(s),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x3cb4e0,side:2}))}
const st=[];for(let i=0;i<14;i++){const m=star();m.position.set((Math.random()-.5)*14,(Math.random()-.5)*14,Math.random()*2);S.add(m);st.push(m)}
let sy=0,T=0;addEventListener('scroll',()=>sy=scrollY/Math.max(1,document.body.scrollHeight-innerHeight));
function rs(){const w=innerWidth,h=innerHeight;R.setSize(w,h,false);C.aspect=w/h;C.updateProjectionMatrix();m=w<800}let m=false;rs();addEventListener('resize',rs);
function tick(){T+=.01;const k=sy;
 g.position.set(m?0:3.4-k*7,m?3.0-k*6:0+Math.sin(T)*.2-k*2,0);g.scale.setScalar(m?.5:1);g.rotation.y=Math.sin(T*.8)*.7+k*10;g.rotation.x=Math.sin(T*.7)*.15+k*2;
 bub.forEach(b=>{b.position.y+=b.userData.s*.01;if(b.position.y>9)b.position.y=-9;b.position.x+=Math.sin(T+b.userData.o)*.003});
 st.forEach((s,i)=>{s.rotation.z+=.01*(i%2?1:-1);s.scale.setScalar(1+Math.sin(T*2+i)*.25)});
 C.position.y=-k*4;R.render(S,C);requestAnimationFrame(tick)}tick();
if(location.search.includes('flat')){document.head.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<style>.hero{min-height:760px}#bg{position:absolute;height:760px!important}</style>')}
const qy=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('y');if(qy){setTimeout(()=>{scrollTo(0,+qy);dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll'))},300)}
</script></body></html>
